senses.gloss:
ट 1. ट, the eleventh consonant of the San-
skṛt alphabet and first of the third class or cerebrals;
it has much the sound of त् in true, but properly pro-
nounced by keeping back the tip of the tongue and
slightly turning it upwards.
—ट-कार, अस्, m. the
letter or sound ट्.
—ट-वर्ग, अस्, m. the cerebral
consonants collectively.
—टवर्गीय, अस्, आ, अम्,
belonging to the cerebral class of consonants.

ट 2. ट, अस्, m. sound or an imitative
sound like the twang of a bow-string &c.; a dwarf;
a quarter, a fourth; (आ), f. the earth; an oath, con-
firming an assertion by ordeal &c.; (अम्), n. a hol-
lowed cocoa-nut.
